info.title: Scryfall Universal API
info.description: Scryfall provides a public API for Magic: The Gathering card search, card details, sets, rulings, symbols, catalogs, and bulk data metadata.

get.description: Finds card names in Scryfall by fuzzy text match.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial card name for autocomplete suggestions.

get.description: Finds cards in Scryfall by search query.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Scryfall full-text search query.

parameters.name: unique
parameters.description: How duplicate prints should be collapsed, such as cards, art, or prints.

schema.description: How duplicate prints should be collapsed, such as cards, art, or prints.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order for matching cards, such as name, set, released, rarity, usd, eur, cmc, power, toughness, or edhrec.

schema.description: Sort order for matching cards, such as name, set, released, rarity, usd, eur, cmc, power, toughness, or edhrec.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Sort direction, auto, asc, or desc.

schema.description: Sort direction, auto, asc, or desc.

parameters.name: includeExtras
parameters.description: Include extra cards such as tokens, planes, schemes, and funny cards.

schema.description: Include extra cards such as tokens, planes, schemes, and funny cards.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page number for paginated card search.

schema.description: Result page number for paginated card search.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
